subject: Your agent-skills on a register that isn't locked to one platform
heading: Your agent-skills on a register that isn't locked to one platform
answer: I run The Agent Register, a marketplace for AI agent skills - the Markdown skills people install into Claude Code, Cursor, opencode, Continue and the rest. I came across agent-skills, and 'production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents' across define, plan, build, verify, review and ship is the most complete set of its kind I have found. The claim on your own site that it works with 70+ agents is the clearest statement of what a skills library should be that I have read.

section1.heading: Why I am writing
section1.body: Every entry in the register is listed as platform-agnostic, and every entry is read and run by a person before it is numbered and published. It is new - four entries so far - so I am writing to people whose skills I would actually want listed rather than waiting for people to find us.

section2.heading: What listing would mean
bullets: A free listing is the default. The entry links to your repo and says what the skill does and what it needs. Your repo stays exactly as it is.

If you ever have something that is genuinely not free - a bundle, a supported edition, a tier - the register has a checkout for it, takes no commission, and the money goes straight to your own PayPal.me.
Nothing goes live without you reading the entry first.
